client: Hi Luna, it's been really tough lately. Since my dad passed away two months ago, I just can't seem to find any joy in my day-to-day activities. I feel so disconnected from my friends, like there’s a wall between us, and I’m not sure if this is something therapy can really help with.
therapist: I can hear the depth of your sadness and the heaviness you’re carrying, especially with the loss of your dad. It’s completely understandable to feel disconnected and to struggle with finding joy right now. Therapy can be a space to explore these feelings and find ways to reconnect, even when it feels like there’s a wall between you and others. How does it feel to share this with me today?
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, fast speech
